items.text: Puka Nacua (hip) officially inactive for Monday night vs Giants, confirming prior GTD/trending wrong way reports.
items.why: Hip injury; official inactive list and multiple reports.
items.implication: Zero for MNF; pivot needed. Rams WR targets redistribute.
items.opportunity: Increased snaps/routes/targets for remaining Rams pass-catchers including Davante Adams.

items.text: Eagles TE Dallas Goedert suffered sprained MCL vs Titans; likely to miss a few weeks. Zach Ertz signed to practice squad as depth.
items.why: Tests confirmed sprained MCL; joint report with Rapoport.
items.implication: TE void in PHI offense short-term; Hurts/ targets shift to WRs or fill-in TE.
items.opportunity: Stream PHI TE or boost DeVonta Smith/A.J. Brown? wait listed NE but usage to other skill.

items.text: Jayden Daniels (dislocated left elbow) underwent imaging Monday and will consult experts per team protocol. Marcus Mariota expected to start vs Seattle. No fracture reported earlier.
items.why: Dislocated non-throwing elbow on fall; further testing.
items.implication: Mariota start; slight downgrade to WAS pass-catchers like Terry McLaurin, Stefon Diggs, Deebo Samuel.
items.opportunity: Handcuff/backup QB stream if needed; monitor timeline.

items.text: Bears HC Ben Johnson says Caleb Williams is week-to-week with hamstring injury (MRI Monday); expectation he will likely miss some time. Same left hamstring as prior college injury. Tyson Bagent is backup.
items.why: Hamstring pull on scramble; coach comments and MRI.
items.implication: Miss at least Week 3 likely; Bears QB downgrade and pass-catcher volatility.
items.opportunity: Monitor Bagent or temporary starter impact on Rome Odunze, DJ Moore, Colston Loveland, Luther Burden.

items.text: Packers WR Jayden Reed injured his back Sunday; spent night in NJ, returning to GB; team evaluating treatment and recovery timeframe. (ETR noted head earlier).
items.why: Back injury per source; evaluation ongoing.
items.implication: Potential miss time; GB WR depth (Watson, Wicks, etc.) opportunity.
items.opportunity: Christian Watson or Dontayvion Wicks role bump if out.

items.text: Bucky Irving separating nicely from Kenny Gainwell: out-snapped 51-23, carries 17-2, routes 22-12. Through two weeks opportunities 36 vs 12. Sean Tucker active but 0 offensive snaps.
items.why: Clear snap/carry/route separation in Week 2 and cumulative.
items.implication: Irving locked as lead back; Gainwell limited change-of-pace.
items.opportunity: High snap share, carries, routes for Irving; start with confidence. Gainwell handcuff only.

items.text: Rhamondre Stevenson lost another fumble (7th in last 31 games) and was punished with playing time. NE weapon-deficient offense needs TreVeyon Henderson explosiveness often, especially with A.J. Brown out. Even split on touches makes sense.
items.why: Fumble punishment + offensive need for explosiveness while Brown sidelined.
items.implication: Henderson role expansion; Stevenson not full bellcow.

items.text: DeVonta Smith RIDE OR DIE after 27% and 38% target shares in first two games; leading all WRs in expected PPR points per model.
items.why: Elite target share and expected points early; Goedert absence may sustain.
items.implication: Must-start WR1/2 with high floor/ceiling on volume.
items.opportunity: Targets, routes, red-zone in PHI offense.

items.text: Saquon Barkley will have MRI after stinger but hope is minor injury; he played through it.
items.implication: Optimistic short-term; monitor results for Week 3 availability.
items.opportunity: If limited, Gainwell or other PHI RBs but primary is Barkley.

items.text: Ladd McConkey officially ACTIVE (cracked rib, optimism/flak jacket). RJ Harvey inactive (hamstring); grab related stashes if ignored preseason.
items.why: Official active; prior ETR optimism and Rap bullish tone. Harvey not expected/inactive.
items.implication: McConkey playable with possible docks; Harvey zero, backup RB opportunity in DEN.
items.opportunity: McConkey routes/targets if limited; DEN RB handcuff/next-man-up.

items.text: Quentin Johnston YPRR by year: 2023 0.88, 2024 1.63, 2025 1.44, 2026 0.48 (inconceivably horrific).
items.implication: Hard to trust despite potential volume in LAC.
items.opportunity: Prefer other Chargers if available; Ladd McConkey safer.

items.text: Marvin Harrison Jr. down to 0.53 yards per route run this season; only a few WRs worse (incl. Quentin Johnston, Jordan Addison).
items.why: Extremely low YPRR efficiency early season.
items.implication: Concern on separation/production despite targets; monitor role.
items.opportunity: If volume holds maybe floor, else fade efficiency.

items.text: 49ers HC Kyle Shanahan did not believe Mike Evans’ hip injury was serious; could have returned in fourth quarter if needed. (Demarcus Robinson high ankle separate).
items.implication: Minimal long-term concern; monitor practice but likely available soon.

items.text: Weekend status: Zay Flowers (hamstring) OUT, Michael Pittman (foot) OUT. Olave/Burrow expected to play. (McConkey/Puka were GTD at time).
items.implication: Flowers absence boosts other BAL WRs; Pittman out opens IND WR targets (Downs, Pierce, Warren).
items.opportunity: BAL: Bateman etc.; IND: Josh Downs, Alec Pierce, Tyler Warren targets/routes.
